import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    x = data[1]  # the string
    ch = list(x)

    max_len = 0
    countw = 0
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        # outside parentheses: count word until '_' or '('
        if ch[i] != '_' and ch[i] != '(':
            count = 0
            j = i
            while True:
                if ch[j] != '_' and ch[j] != '(':
                    count += 1
                if ch[j] == '_' or ch[j] == '(' or j == n - 1:
                    max_len = max(max_len, count)
                    i = j
                    break
                j += 1

        # inside parentheses
        if ch[i] == '(':
            count = 0
            j = i
            while j < n:
                if (ch[j] == '_' or ch[j] == ')') and count > 0:
                    countw += 1
                    count = 0
                if ch[j] == ')':
                    i = j
                    break
                if ch[j] != '_' and ch[j] != '(':
                    count += 1
                j += 1
        i += 1

    print(f"{max_len} {countw}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
